mapper.select: SELECT ca.id, ca.course_id, ca.file_id, f.original_name AS file_name, f.size AS byte_size, ca.sort_order, ca.created_at FROM tb_course_attachments ca JOIN tb_files f ON f.id = ca.file_id WHERE ca.course_id = #{courseId} AND ca.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ca.sort_order ASC, ca.created_at ASC, ca.id ASC
